description:
"Stunning River Views"

Modern apartment in the heart of Durham, ready to move in straight away.

The Tour

The apartment block is accessed via a communal front entrance, it is situated on the 3rd floor. The front door opens onto your hallway leading to, lounge, kitchen diner with french doors leading to blacony area. From the hallway there is also a master bathroom and two bedrooms, one with an en suite shower room.

External Space

The property benefits from balcony entered from the living area and has wonderful river views.

Local Area

Situated in the heart of Durham, with many local amenities nearby and in easy walking distance to the Cathedral and University, this property is the perfect location for an investment or anyone wanting the Durham centre lifestyle.
